verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs say Workers can query serverless SQL "directly from Workers with no connection management" (cloudflare-docs-4). D1 databases are created via `wrangler d1 create` (cloudflare-docs-38), and data stores are attached through Bindings in a few lines of code (cloudflare-docs-10); community posts confirm D1 is a real offering used with Workers. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing the actual D1 query API and binding usage, independent hands-on corroboration of querying from Worker code.
